# Wire an architecture runtime library through acquisition and linking

662 adds the Windows Arm64 compiler-rt artifact to both Clang repacks and reference-task selection. 663 links clang_rt.builtins-aarch64.lib into the RNP library and both command-line tools. The commit message identifies 128-bit math dependencies as the reason. Current compiler repacks still fetch Arm64 runtime artifacts, now at version 22; the old explicit RNP LDFLAGS branches are absent. Preserve the historical integration chain without prescribing an obsolete version or reintroducing those flags. No Windows Arm64 link or packaging validation was run.

Scope: Windows Arm64 compiler runtime integration.
